93.description: These tokens represent non-English or foreign-language character fragments and diacritics.

1.description: This vector represents common Hindi vowel matras (dependent vowel signs) combined with punctuation marks or trailing characters.

2.description: This feature vector represents characters and phonemes from the Japanese and Hindi writing systems.

11.description: This vector is related to numbers in the one-hundred-eighties range.

168.description: This feature vector activates on a random assortment of multilingual text fragments, punctuation marks, and HTML tag components without a cohesive semantic theme.

41.description: This vector activates strongly for Hindi and Devanagari script characters alongside specific consonants and numbers.

196.description: These tokens represent various combinations of Hindi consonants combined with different vowel diacritics.

34.description: This vector activates on various Hindi vowel signs and punctuation marks attached to commas.

54.description: This vector activates on fragments and characters from multilingual proper nouns, loanwords, and mixed-script text tokens.

36.description: This vector is related to uppercase acronyms, state abbreviations, and single-letter token fragments.
